title: Claims Manual — Veterans' Group Life Insurance (VGLI) Death Claims
content:
# Claims Manual — Veterans' Group Life Insurance (VGLI) Death Claims

## Settlement rule

On the insured's death while coverage is in force (including the grace period), the coverage less any accelerated benefit already paid, and less an overdue premium when death occurs in the grace period, is paid to the beneficiaries as a lump sum or in 36 monthly installments. Premiums paid for months after the month of death are refunded to the estate. A claim should be filed within 2 years of the death.

This rule governs death claims on every Veterans' Group Life Insurance (VGLI) coverage tier.

## The amount payable

The death benefit is worked from the policy's coverage amount:

1. start from the coverage amount of the policy;
2. deduct any accelerated benefit already paid on the policy;
3. where death occurs during the grace period, deduct the overdue premium as well.

The two deductions are each taken from the coverage amount; neither is a percentage, and each is deducted once.

| Circumstance at death | Accelerated benefit already paid | Deducted from the coverage |
|---|---|---|
| coverage in force, premiums current | none | nothing |
| coverage in force, premiums current | yes | the accelerated benefit paid |
| in the grace period | none | the overdue premium |
| in the grace period | yes | the accelerated benefit paid and the overdue premium |

## Worked settlements (hypothetical policies)

*All figures below are hypothetical inputs chosen for illustration.*

- **VGLI $200,000 Coverage, premiums current, no accelerated benefit.** Benefit: $200,000.
- **VGLI $200,000 Coverage, accelerated benefit of $100,000 paid earlier, death in the grace period with an overdue monthly premium of $48.00.** $200,000 less $100,000 less $48.00 gives a benefit of $99,952.00.
- **VGLI $50,000 Coverage, death in the grace period with an overdue premium of $12.00, no accelerated benefit.** $50,000 less $12.00 gives a benefit of $49,988.00.

## How the benefit is received

A beneficiary may receive the death benefit in one of two ways:

- a lump sum; or
- 36 monthly installments.

## Premium paid beyond the month of death

Premiums paid for months after the month of death are refunded to the estate. The month in which death occurs is not a month after the month of death.

*Hypothetical:* an annual premium covering January through December was paid at a monthly premium of $48.00, and the insured died on 10 June. July through December — six months — are months after the month of death; $48.00 multiplied by 6, that is $288.00, is refunded to the estate.

## Filing period

A claim should be filed within 2 years of the death.

## Points of judgement

- *Is a death benefit paid when death occurs during the grace period?* Yes. Coverage is in force during the grace period; the benefit is paid less the overdue premium.
- *Is premium for the month of death refunded?* No. The refund is of premiums paid for months after the month of death, and it goes to the estate.
